text:
Elena: Heads-up: ops wants to lift the runtime pin on 2.19 for quant-v5 in eu-west during the 01:30 UTC maintenance window. Reason: fix for beam-search hotspot. Need brief signoff and a clear rollback cut.

Chris: any canary data? specifically looking for long-tail token latency or embedding regressions.

Elena: ran a short canary this morning. net improvement on avg tokens but saw a rare pod that spiked memory on heavy n > 8k sequences. summary: p50 160ms->145ms, p95 310ms->295ms, p99 flat. mem spike observed in 3/120 pods in stress run.

Priya: let's be conservative: 5% cohort first, monitor 45m. rollback if p99 +7% or error-rate +1%. also ensure enterprise/dedicated customers remain on pinned runtime.

Ops_Night: OK. We'll schedule cohort at 01:35 UTC and keep an ops hold till 03:00 UTC. assign me as watcher.

Elena: deploybot, please produce the pinlist diff and create a rollback job. Also check model compatibility table for any models forced to older runtimes.

deploybot: [deploybot] pinlist-diff: runtime 2.19 -> proposed unpin for quant-v5 in eu-west. Canary job created: start=01:35 UTC, cohort=5%, duration=45m. Rollback job id: rb-runtime-2.19-euw. Models checked: all quant-v5 bindings compatible (min runtime 2.15).

Chris: add alert rules: relative p99 > +7% over baseline OR error rate increase > +1% over baseline. also add a synthetic test for a 10k sequence to watch OOM patterns.

Priya: noted. I'll update the release note snippet: "Runtime: experimental unpin of 2.19 for quant-v5 in eu-west during maintenance window to apply beam-search hotspot fix. Initial cohort 5%, rollback if p99 >+7% or errors >+1%. Dedicated customers excluded." Will push after quick review.

Elena: ops checklist: (1) ensure dedicated pools are pinned, (2) schedule canary, (3) monitoring hooks + synthetic 10k seq, (4) rollback job ready, (5) post-canary decision at 02:25 UTC.

Ops_Night: acknowledged. quick rollback command for night: `./ops/run-rollback.sh rb-runtime-2.19-euw` and link to playbook: https://go/release/unpin-playbook.

deploybot: [deploybot] canary started 01:35 UTC; cohort 5%; monitoring enabled.

Chris: watching metrics. ping if anything noisy.

Elena: approved by oncall :white_check_mark:. If canary passes we'll plan broad unpin at 02:45 UTC. If we hit rollback criteria -> run rb-runtime-2.19-euw and open incident channel.

Priya: leaving a postmortem stub in the docs repo in case it's needed: "window, cohort, metrics, faulty pods, remediation"

Ops_Night: will keep watch and escalate to runtime team if alerts fire.

Elena: thanks team. I'll update the pinlist once we close the canary.
